title: Phone deal: Samsung Galaxy A56
prompt:
A vertical 9:16 offer announcement ad for a phone shop in Rwanda. Setting: a glass counter in a Kigali phone shop. Light: bright, clean shop light. Music: punchy electronic beat.
The Samsung Galaxy A56 must look exactly as in Image 1: same shape, colours, logo and label.
0-2s: Close-up, fast whip pan: along a row of phones on the glass counter, stopping on the Samsung Galaxy A56 from Image 1. Sound: a whoosh.
2-5s: Close-up, slow push-in: the Samsung Galaxy A56 lights up as a hand picks it up.
5-8s: Clean hero shot, subject centred, locked-off static camera: the Samsung Galaxy A56 centred on the glass counter, bright and clean. A warm voice-over says in English: "Samsung Galaxy A56: 420,000 RWF."
No on-screen text or added logos.

storyboard.notice: Preview: Seedance arrives with the BytePlus key. This is the shot plan Seedance will film; no credits were taken.
